commands.description: Displays elapsed time since the last system boot.
Displays a condensed status table of all interfaces (name, admin state, link state, speed).
Displays full interface statistics including error counters and traffic rates.
Displays installed hardware components and serial numbers.
Displays a summary table of configured VLANs and their member interfaces.

commands.command: set interfaces unit family inet address
commands.syntax: set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 10.1.1.1/24 [family inet6 address <ipv6>]
commands.description: Assigns an IPv4 (and optionally IPv6) address to the specified interface.
Creates a VLAN and assigns it a VLAN ID. The option name changed from vlan-id to id.
Sets the device's hostname.
Sets the root password interactively. Now requires a --min-complexity flag.
Removes the configuration for the specified interface. Now prompts for confirmation before applying, unless run with --force.
Applies the active candidate configuration.
Applies the configuration but automatically rolls back if not confirmed within the given time. The unit changed from minutes to seconds.
Reverts to a previous committed configuration by rollback number.
Displays the current active configuration.
Displays a detailed per-protocol breakdown of routes per routing table. Replaces the old summary-only view.
Enables LLDP-MED (Media Endpoint Discovery) on all interfaces. Replaces the plain LLDP command.

commands.command: set snmp v3 usm local-engine user
commands.syntax: set snmp v3 usm local-engine user admin authentication-sha
commands.description: Configures an SNMPv3 user with authentication. Replaces community-string based SNMPv2 access.
Displays the system message log.
Reboots the device.
Displays active system alarms.
Displays Power-over-Ethernet status and power draw for the specified interface.

commands.syntax: set security zones security-zone trust interfaces ge-0/0/0
commands.description: Assigns an interface to a security zone.
Displays disk and storage partition usage.
Administratively disables the specified interface.
